metadata.label: Newborns, first names normally used, by year of naming and sex. Year 1998-2022
note: For the period 2004 and forward, includes first names normally used with at least two persons with this name of the same sex among newborns named that year.  For the period 1998–2003, includes first names normally used with at least ten persons with this name of the same sex among newborns named that year.  .. = fewer than 2 persons and 10 persons with that name respectively.   Each spelling variant of a name is presented as a unique name.
